name: Mocking Jibe
body:
School enchantment [language-dependent, mind-affecting]; Level bard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

You unleash magically-enhanced insults and verbal jabs at a target in range. If the target can hear you, they must make a Will save or be dealt 1d4 damage and take a -1 penalty on attack rolls and concentration checks until your next turn. A successful save halves the damage and negates the penalty.
